-- ContextSeal safe expansion: keep the old field during consumer migration
select
  customer_email,
  customer_id,
  updated_at,
  customer_email as contact_email
from {{ ref('gold_customers') }}

version: 2
models:
  - name: gold_customers_contextseal
    description: "ContextSeal migration candidate; strategy EXPAND_MIGRATE_CONTRACT."
    meta:
      contextseal:
        run_id: "csr_dbef9132dc5175d4c7dc140c392700ed"
        policy_version: "2026-07-14"
        policy_hash: "eadf377cceb74742db8523466ec4fd700574e55e4786bbc993c7985053d31a82"
        migration_strategy: "EXPAND_MIGRATE_CONTRACT"
        target_platform: "snowflake"
        dialect: "snowflake"
        intended_deprecation_window: "Retain the source field until every known downstream consumer migrates and a later scoped approval authorizes removal."
    columns:
      - name: customer_email
        tests:
          - not_null
      - name: contact_email

-- ContextSeal rename parity test: returns rows only when compatibility values diverge
select
  customer_email as source_value,
  contact_email as compatibility_value
from {{ ref('gold_customers_contextseal') }}
where customer_email is distinct from contact_email

-- Rollback keeps the original field authoritative
select
  customer_email,
  customer_id,
  updated_at
from {{ ref('gold_customers_contextseal') }}
